# Bojan Bosanac

> Senior iOS Developer with 12+ years of experience building scalable mobile
> applications across fintech, healthcare, automotive, sports, and
> communication platforms. Based in Novi Sad, Serbia (CET), remote-friendly.

## Summary

- Freelance Senior iOS Developer & Backend Developer (2020 — now): production
  iOS apps end to end (architecture through App Store release and support)
  for clients in fintech, sports, restaurant management, staffing, and
  communication; backend integrations in Swift Vapor, Kotlin, and PHP.
- Product Owner & Mobile Developer, Continental Automotive (Dec 2019 — Nov
  2020): led mobile architecture on the Remote Vehicle Data (RVD) platform,
  introduced Clean Architecture, mentored developers.
- Mobile Team Lead & Senior iOS Developer, Vega IT (2014 — 2019): led mobile
  development on fintech and healthcare projects (mobile banking, GraphQL
  healthcare apps), mentored developers.
- MSc Computer & Control Engineering, Faculty of Technical Sciences,
  University of Novi Sad (2015).

Core stack: Swift, Objective-C, Kotlin, Java, PHP · MVVM, VIPER, VIP, Clean
Architecture, Coordinators · REST, GraphQL, Vapor, WebSockets, .NET Core ·
CI/CD, Agile/Scrum, mentoring, technical leadership.
